description: This file defines the class PayGradeConfigurator which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It is used to configure menu items related to pay grades within the Admin module of the OrangeHRM system. The class utilizes a trait for module screen helper functions and overrides the current screen to 'viewPayGrades'.

classes.name: PayGradeConfigurator
classes.description: A class that implements menu configuration for the pay grade section within the admin module, overriding the current screen to 'viewPayGrades'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the screen by overriding it to 'viewPayGrades' and returns null.
